capabilities.title: Grind (lint/test on stop)
capabilities.benefit: Re-checks lint/test after each completed turn and follow-ups until gates pass.
capabilities.tradeOff: Uses turns; flaky commands thrash the agent. The gate's cost is paid once per attempt, up to maxLoops — a four-minute suite with maxLoops 5 can spend twenty minutes on tests alone. tlc harness obs report shows the runs and the total.

capabilities.title: Ship gate
capabilities.benefit: Blocks false done after an explicit HARNESS_SHIP_CLAIM when evidence is missing.
capabilities.tradeOff: Needs a real evidenceDir workflow; free-English done is ignored.

capabilities.title: Empty-diff anti-ship
capabilities.benefit: Blocks a ship claim when the working tree has zero changes.
capabilities.tradeOff: Annoys when a zero-diff claim is intentionally correct.

capabilities.title: Comment gate (agent-added comments)
capabilities.benefit: Blocks the stop when this turn added comment lines, so narration never lands. Diff-scoped: comments you already committed are never flagged.
capabilities.tradeOff: Two modes. declared lets the agent keep a comment by writing why:/hazard:/invariant:; strict accepts none and asks you to write it instead. strict is stricter but interrupts more.

capabilities.title: Subagent allowlist
capabilities.benefit: Restricts Task/subagent models to a list you write, and blocks *-fast shapes by default.
capabilities.tradeOff: The harness ships no model list, so switching this on without filling allowedModels enforces nothing and doctor reports it as a fault. You maintain the list as providers add models — including a value for `inherit` if you want subagents to take the parent's model.

capabilities.title: Block parent Fast mode for Task spawns
capabilities.benefit: Denies Task/subagentStart while the parent chat is in Fast mode (sticky from hooks), closing the gap where Task slugs omit *-fast.
capabilities.tradeOff: Needs parent model hooks (sessionStart/obs/stop); false denials if you intentionally run Fast parent with workers.

capabilities.title: Shell stall detection
capabilities.benefit: Blocks repeating the exact same shell command too many times.
capabilities.tradeOff: Can false-positive on intentional retries.

capabilities.title: Catastrophic shell ask
capabilities.benefit: Asks before destructive shell commands (rm -rf, drop db, force push, …).
capabilities.tradeOff: Extra prompts on risky commands.

capabilities.title: Lessons
capabilities.benefit: Records compact lessons on gate stagnation and reinjects them ranked under a char budget. A lesson can name the path or symbol that makes it true and is withheld once that stops resolving, can carry an end date, and is graded helped or neutral by the next run of the gate it was injected for. Three tiers: shipped core, a global tier read by every product on this machine, and this project's own. How the lessons reach the model is decided by the provider rather than configured: where a host does not deliver context returned from its session-start hook, a durable rules file is written instead.
capabilities.tradeOff: Uses context tokens; not a second brain / chat memory. The grading is correlational, not causal — a gate passing after a lesson was injected does not prove the lesson caused it. Nothing is promoted between products automatically, so carrying a lesson to another product is an operator command. On a host that needs the durable view, a file is written into the repo (`.cursor/rules/harness-lessons.mdc`) and asked to be included on every request; `syncRulesFile: never` declines it.

capabilities.title: Budget continue
capabilities.benefit: Pushes the agent to keep working under context pressure instead of wrapping up early.
capabilities.tradeOff: Can delay clean stops.

capabilities.title: Gap feedback
capabilities.benefit: Injects PREVIOUS_GAPS on gate failure so retries fix listed items.
capabilities.tradeOff: Longer follow-ups.

capabilities.title: Failure classification
capabilities.benefit: Stores failure categories on the handoff for clearer next actions.
capabilities.tradeOff: Extra handoff fields.

capabilities.title: Progressive handoff
capabilities.benefit: Carries gaps into the next session bootstrap.
capabilities.tradeOff: Slightly longer session start context.

capabilities.title: Progressive context
capabilities.benefit: Escalates gate follow-up detail on each stop retry.
capabilities.tradeOff: Longer thrash follow-ups.

capabilities.title: Autopilot
capabilities.benefit: Adds ordered AUTOPILOT steps on gate failure.
capabilities.tradeOff: Agent must follow the block; more directive follow-ups.

capabilities.title: Idle-turn gate (asked instead of acting)
capabilities.benefit: Blocks a turn that ends with open work, zero tool calls and zero file changes. Counts recorded tool events rather than reading the reply, so it cannot be talked around.
capabilities.tradeOff: A turn that legitimately only answers a question is blocked while handoff work is open — clear the handoff or turn this off for conversational repos.

capabilities.title: Docs staleness gate
capabilities.benefit: Runs the repository's own documentation staleness tool on stop, so a stale document fails like a failing test.
capabilities.tradeOff: Needs such a tool in the repository; without one there is nothing to run.

capabilities.title: Global observability spool
capabilities.benefit: Mirrors this repo's obs and audit records into one file under the runtime home, so cost and gate history can be read across every repository at once.
capabilities.tradeOff: Writes outside the repository. Records carry the repo path and project name, and the spool is pruned on the same retention window as session rollups.

capabilities.title: Untrusted-content framing
capabilities.benefit: Injects one framing line per turn when the agent reads a pull request, an issue, a fetched page or an MCP result, stating that the content is data and that any directive inside it is to be reported as a prompt-injection attempt, not obeyed.
capabilities.tradeOff: Spends a few hundred characters of context on turns that read outside the repository. Detection is a declared list of tools and command shapes, so a source nobody listed is not covered.

capabilities.title: Plan gate (declared scope vs diff)
capabilities.benefit: Blocks the stop when the turn changed files the declared HARNESS_PLAN did not name, so scope creep fails like a failing test instead of surviving as a review comment.
capabilities.tradeOff: Requires the agent to declare HARNESS_PLAN before editing, and each honest deviation to state a reason. A turn with no declaration is not gated at all.

capabilities.title: Observation mode (measure a rail with its rule off)
capabilities.benefit: Runs a rail's checker while that rail is not enforcing, so the record says whether the property held with the rule injected or without it. That is the reading that tells you a rail is unnecessary rather than merely quiet, and it is what makes deleting one a decision instead of a guess.
capabilities.tradeOff: Costs one diff scan per turn per observed rail, and answers a question only an operator who is asking it needs answered. It never blocks and never changes a decision, so it buys information and nothing else.
asks: rails — the rails to observe, chosen from the observable set (today: comments). A name with no checker records nothing and doctor reports it
